_comment: The photo library behind the Instagram feed. Eight interiors — aparthotel,
co-living, furnished and bedroom — cycled across the 20 posts so no two
Generated images, not photographs of real listings, and deliberately empty:
a housing post that pictures who lives somewhere is a fair-housing problem,
and a generated interior must never be passed off as an actual home. They
illustrate the categories RentLeaks lists; they never stand in for a listing.
The files are not in the repository — they are fetched once:
which downloads them into images/social/photos/ and re-renders the feed.
Until then tools/build-ig-feed.py draws the painted cards instead, so the
feed always renders and nothing is ever half-made.
To swap one for a real photograph, drop your own JPEG in at the same file
name and re-run tools/build-ig-feed.py. Landscape or portrait both work —
the renderer crops to fill — but portrait 4:5 loses the least.
